name: gg-academy-platform
description: Full-stack gaming e-learning and store platform replicating GG Academy

scripts.setup: npm run setup:server && npm run setup:client
scripts.build: cd client && npm install && npm run build
scripts.render:build: cd client && npm install && npm run build && npx prisma generate && npx prisma db push && npm run prisma:seed
scripts.postinstall: npx prisma generate && (npx prisma db push || true) && cd client && npm install && npm run build
